_readme: Your local overrides. This file is yours; reinstalling will not overwrite it.
这是你自己的配置文件，重新安装不会覆盖它。
allow   -- regex patterns that are never inspected, checked before any rule.
Use this when the guard keeps stopping something you do every day.
当某条日常命令被反复拦截时，写在这里放行。
disable -- rule ids to switch off entirely.
The id is printed in every message, e.g. [filesystem] rm-rf-broad
要彻底关掉的规则 id，每次拦截提示里都会显示。
rules   -- your own rules. Reusing a built-in id overrides that rule.
自定义规则；id 与内置规则相同则覆盖内置规则。
balanced 模式下：critical 直接拒绝，high 和 medium 询问。
An example rule you might want, if you have a production server:
"zh": "这条命令会连到生产服务器，请自己手动执行。",
"en": "This connects to a production server. Do that yourself."
